competences.description: Attacks all enemies to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken and resist death.
Increases the Ancient Guardian's Attack Power and Defense by 50%, and decreases the enemy's Attack Power for 2 turns by 50% chance when attacking the enemy. [Automatic Effect]
Attacks all enemies 2 times to deal damage proportional to the Ancient Guardian's Attack Speed, decreasing Defense for 2 turns each.
Attacks enemies randomly 12 times with ancient sword energy to decrease the enemy's Attack Bar by 10% each and creates a shield on itself by 10% of the damage dealt for 2 turns.
